note: Evidence ledger of scientific corrections (sci-fix). correctness: C0 none, C1 pinned values or behavioral assertions only, C2 one independent oracle kind, C3 two or more independent oracle kinds plus an invariant and a negative control, C4 exhaustive or symbolic over a stated finite domain. discrimination: D0 no record that the evidence failed on the parent, D1 a combined count or before/after values only, D2 a per-test parent record (fails on the parent, passes on the fix) for every oracle node named by the entry's independence records, or, for an entry without one, for its regression tests (D-scope rule, maintainer decision 2026-10-22); D3 D2 plus a killed revert mutant. Each entry records commits (parent, fix, follow_up: 40-hex), parent_records (test, parent, fix, failure, env, adapted_parent, adaptation, validation, requires) and mutants (function, mutation, killed_by, detail); evidence_tests lists the nodes of both. The axes are reported separately and never combined. Requirements: S1 C3 and D2; S2 C2 and D2; S4 C1 and D2. A negative control that emulates the pre-fix behavior inside the test is evidence on the correctness axis, not a parent record.
assessed: agent audit 2026-10-18 on 0.14.1 (three independent reviewers, same rubric), rechecked and extended on 2026-10-20 (VALIDATION SCIFIX-* sections); reviewed 2026-10-21 under the maintainer's decisions on oracle independence (docs/maintenance.md): every counted independent kind has a basis (locator, third-party, exhaustive or person) in its entry's independence records, locators read at page level or better (VALIDATION SCIFIX-LEDGER-REVIEW); since 2026-10-22 every locator record names its source and located claim (source_id, locator_id in scifix-sources.json and scifix-claims.json) and every independence record lists the import names its oracle test requires (requires: core, backend; VALIDATION SCIFIX-PLAN-B1-B4); on 2026-10-22 the D axis became structured (commits, parent_records, mutants) and every grade was recomputed under the D-scope rule from those records, with the missing parent records rerun in detached worktrees, and ML-SMALL was split into four entries (VALIDATION SCIFIX-PLAN-B3-B6)
